description: Genuine data-quality issues in the MIMIC-IV source that ClearClaim correctly reports but that the synthetic answer key (injected faults only) cannot list. scripts/verify_results.py treats a case listed here as an expected outcome ONLY when (a) the run's clinical source matches, (b) the listed finding is a first-pass root of that case, (c) every other root is an injected fault, and (d) the anomaly is re-confirmed from the source files during verification. Otherwise it remains a completeness problem. The finding stays visible in the application, the raw outputs and the verifier report; nothing is suppressed.

anomalies.evidence: 4 of 5 coded procedures (seq 2-5) are dated 9-25 days after discharge. The dates fall inside the same patient's next two admissions, consistent with a source-side admission linkage error. It is the only such admission in the demo.
